title: A credit on an invoice from before the release keeps today's revenue split
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, created on production before the release.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced on production before the release for two parts, part 1 at $260.00 and part 2 at $40.00 ($300.00).
  • Make sure customer A has no other sales on the day of the credit.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Issue Credit on the invoice.
  4. Tick part 2 to return.
  5. Confirm the credit.
  6. Open the Sales By Customer report for the day of the credit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice.

Step 3:

  • The Issue Credit window opens.

Step 4:

  • Part 2 ($40.00) is ticked.

Step 5:

  • The credit is made.

Step 6:

  • The $40.00 credit is attributed as it would have been before the release (customer A's credit, as today).
  • No existing revenue figure moved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • Feature Overview, Release day: “Credits on invoices created before release keep today's revenue attribution.”
  • S10-R8: “A credit issued from an invoice created after release reduces the revenue of that invoice's customer.”
  • Key Decisions: “A credit issued from an invoice reduces the revenue of that invoice's customer, not the Bill To's. Applies to invoices created after release; older credits keep today's attribution so no existing figure moves.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
